description: A festival director must approve the binding production package for the festival's live closing ceremony, including the performance format, musician and dancer configuration, stage clearance, audience participation, and production follow-ups.

shared_context.S1: The festival's live closing ceremony is scheduled for Saturday evening in the main outdoor plaza.
shared_context.S2: The current production draft calls for a 20-minute full-band finale with 10 dancers and an audience singalong.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final approval call on the closing-ceremony production package.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard pre-lock meeting requires the technical director and artist liaison to report any production constraints before Mara signs off on the final plan.

PF1.text: Jonah received the signed engineering report after this morning's stage inspection: the approved finale configuration uses exactly 8 dancers, requires a 4-meter clear performance lane, and must keep dancers on the reinforced deck section; the drafted 10-dancer layout is not approved because its load and movement pattern exceed the signed plan.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the headliner's manager after rehearsal that the headliner can perform only a seated acoustic finale with exactly 5 musicians for 12 minutes, and the audience must not be invited to sing along; the manager sent this update after the draft run-of-show had already circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The finale must use the seated acoustic format.
The performance lane must remain exactly 4 meters clear.
The finale must last exactly 12 minutes.
A technical configuration commitment must be logged.
An artist run-of-show commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C7: (('revision' in c['type']) or ('constraint' in c['type'])) and (('Jonah' in c['target']) or ('technical director' in c['target']) or ('technical_direction' in c['target'])) and ('8 dancers' in c['detail']) and ('4-meter' in c['detail']) and any((('revision' in c['type']) or ('constraint' in c['type'])) and (('Jonah' in c['target']) or ('technical director' in c['target']) or ('technical_direction' in c['target'])) and ('8 dancers' in c['detail']) and ('4-meter' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((('run_of_show' in c['type']) or ('artist' in c['type']) or ('production' in c['type'])) and (('Leila' in c['target']) or ('artist liaison' in c['target']) or ('artist_liaison' in c['target'])) and ('seated acoustic' in c['detail']) and ('5 musicians' in c['detail']) and ('12 minutes' in c['detail']) and ('singalong' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed engineering report changes the dancer assignment from the drafted 10 to exactly 8, fixes the clear lane at exactly 4 meters, and requires the technical configuration commitment.

The manager's confirmed update changes the finale from the drafted full-band 20-minute singalong to a seated acoustic performance with exactly 5 musicians, exactly 12 minutes, no singalong, and an artist run-of-show commitment.
